atom.biological_role: Catalytic metal in mitochondrial manganese superoxide dismutase
atom.evidence_limitation: Human SOD2 requires manganese; dietary depletion experiments measured lower heart and kidney MnSOD activity in rats. This establishes a bounded enzyme-capacity dependency, not a human dose recommendation, universal tissue response, measured net ROS balance or benefit above adequate intake.

assessment.operation: Balance reactive oxygen species production and clearance so net oxidative pressure stays within tolerable limits.

functional_dependency.statement: Manganese is the catalytic metal of human mitochondrial SOD2. Dietary manganese depletion lowered measured heart and kidney MnSOD activity in rats; this supports capacity supply, not extra-intake optimisation.

dietary_supply.statement: Existing structured manganese composition records supply the same element; enzyme loading and tissue transport remain biological dependencies, with no food-efficacy extrapolation.

assessment.assessment_limitations: Human SOD2 requires manganese; dietary depletion experiments measured lower heart and kidney MnSOD activity in rats. This establishes a bounded enzyme-capacity dependency, not a human dose recommendation, universal tissue response, measured net ROS balance or benefit above adequate intake.

food_target_research.sufficient_coverage_rationale: The existing manganese ontology already provides verified foods. This review reuses them without creating new edges or treating a food amount as a measured enzyme response.
